LanguageData.GR_GoauldFreeSymbioteIncursion_LetterTex: Hostile life signs at the colony perimeter: {0}. They have been identified as adult Goa'uld symbiotes moving under their own direction and seeking living humanoid hosts. Keep them away from anyone you cannot afford to lose.

Movement at the edge of the colony has been identified as free Goa'uld symbiotes. Detected contacts: {0}. No Jaffa escort is visible. The creatures themselves are the assault, and each will attempt to reach and implant a compatible host.

An uncontained Goa'uld presence is closing on the settlement. Detected contacts: {0}. The approach is scattered but deliberate. Intercept the creatures before they can cross the last distance to a colonist.
